summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting the appointment of Drew Anwyll, P.Eng. (formerly COO) as CEO, replacing Nick Campbell who is stepping down and departing the company, effective immediately. No financial terms, stake, premium, or consideration are disclosed. The board thanked the outgoing CEO for his contributions. This is a forced/abrupt CEO departure rather than a routine management transition, as it involves a direct replacement effective immediately with the departing CEO leaving the company. Watch for potential strategic shifts under new leadership and any impact on project advancement.
